Team Createscape

Team Createscape is dedicated to fostering a vibrant and supportive coworking community. Whether we're assisting members and guests, organizing engaging events, or handling communications, our goal is to create a welcoming space where creativity and collaboration thrive.

Keller Davis

Founder & Owner

Keller is an Austin native and a creative entrepreneur. He is a video producer, filmmaker, writer, and community builder who loves traveling, dogs, and supporting local art.

Lauren Giebitz

Community Manager

Lauren, born and raised in Austin, is passionate about coffee, movies, and plants. When she's not practicing martial arts, you can find her at a local coffee shop or adding to her ever-growing plant collection.

Fletcher Haley

Community Associate

Fletcher is an Austin native with a love for travel, art, and baking. A proud cat person and music enthusiast, Fletcher enjoys connecting over creative projects and unwinding with video games, even if they're not her strong suit.

Chris Billig

Communications Specialist

Chris works with progressive and nonprofit fundraising data and has a passion for British culture. Outside of work, he enjoys researching genealogy and competing in a national quiz league.
